item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hi, I’m xiaoojs20

Welcome to my personal space.

I study electrical engineering at Tsinghua University and am also interested in artificial intelligence, search and recommendation systems, and data analysis. I enjoy exploring across fields and turning ideas into things that are useful in everyday life.

This is where I share what I learn, the projects I work on, and moments from daily life: sometimes a carefully written note, sometimes a photograph, and sometimes an idea that is still taking shape.

Experience

  1. Tsinghua University · M.S. in Electrical Engineering

    Sep 2024 — Jun 2027 (expected)

    Studying renewable energy and power systems, and exploring reinforcement learning and intelligent optimization.

  2. Baidu · Algorithm Intern

    Apr 2026 — Oct 2026

    Worked on feed advertising models, with a focus on generative models and multichannel information fusion.

  3. Shopee · Search Algorithm Intern

    Oct 2025 — Mar 2026

    Worked on relevance models for e-commerce search.

  4. Meituan · Recommendation Algorithm Intern

    Mar 2025 — Jul 2025

    Explored the use of large language models in candidate retrieval for homepage recommendations.

  5. Tsinghua University · B.S. in Electrical Engineering

    Sep 2020 — Jun 2024

    Majored in electrical engineering and automation, with a minor in software engineering.

Beyond work

Outside work and study, I care about fitness and health and enjoy recording photographs and everyday moments. I’ve also built a tool for tracking my workouts. I hope this website can be a space that grows gradually over time.
